tools.name: get-workspace-summary
tools.description: Returns a limited, read-only summary of the authenticated FieldRobin workspace.

tools.name: search-customers
tools.description: Searches the authenticated workspace customers without exposing addresses, notes, or other private fields.

tools.name: search-jobs
tools.description: Searches the authenticated workspace jobs using safe summary fields only; it does not return service addresses, notes, or amounts.

tools.name: get-customer
tools.description: Returns one authorized customer using bounded contact and lifecycle fields; addresses and notes are excluded.

tools.name: get-job
tools.description: Returns one authorized job using bounded customer, schedule, status, and technician fields; service addresses, notes, and amounts are excluded.

tools.name: search-leads
tools.description: Searches authorized workspace leads with bounded contact, source, status, and service-interest fields; notes and estimated values are excluded.

tools.name: jobs-today
tools.description: Lists authorized jobs scheduled for a business day, with bounded customer, schedule, status, and technician fields.

tools.name: get-lead
tools.description: Returns one authorized lead using bounded contact, source, status, and service-interest fields; notes, budget, and internal summaries are excluded.

tools.name: search-quotes
tools.description: Searches authorized estimates using bounded customer, status, title, and total fields; notes, terms, and addresses are excluded.

tools.name: get-quote
tools.description: Returns one authorized estimate with bounded customer, status, pricing, revision, and line-item fields; addresses, notes, and terms are excluded.

tools.name: preview-quote
tools.description: Calculates a deterministic estimate preview without saving, sending, or creating a quote.

tools.name: search-invoices
tools.description: Searches authorized invoices using bounded customer, job, status, payment, due-date, and total fields; payment links and addresses are excluded.

tools.name: get-invoice
tools.description: Returns one authorized invoice with bounded customer, job, payment-state, due-date, and line-item fields; payment links, addresses, and internal notes are excluded.

tools.name: preview-invoice
tools.description: Calculates a deterministic invoice preview without saving, charging, sending, or creating an invoice.

tools.name: schedule-availability
tools.description: Calculates verified busy jobs and open planning windows for a local business day without scheduling or changing a job.

tools.name: pipeline-next-actions
tools.description: Lists persisted pipeline attention items for the authenticated business without changing, dismissing, or executing them.

tools.name: pipeline-recommendations
tools.description: Lists persisted pipeline recommendations for the authenticated business without generating, editing, approving, rejecting, or executing them.

tools.name: customer-service-requests
tools.description: Lists recent active service requests associated with one authorized customer using bounded status, source, urgency, and scheduling fields.

tools.name: search-service-requests
tools.description: Finds bounded active service-request inbox records for the authenticated business without exposing request descriptions, addresses, contact channels, or outreach controls.

tools.name: get-service-request
tools.description: Returns one authorized service-request inbox record using bounded status, source, urgency, and scheduling fields without exposing request descriptions, addresses, contact channels, metadata, files, or outreach controls.

tools.name: get-invoice-payment-status
tools.description: Returns the authoritative payment state for one authorized invoice without exposing payment links or provider identifiers.

tools.name: preview-review-requests
tools.description: Previews explicit completed jobs for review requests, including eligibility and skip reasons, without sending anything.

tools.name: search-reviews
tools.description: Searches authorized reviews by reviewer, customer, job, rating, platform, or reply status using bounded fields.

tools.name: draft-review-reply
tools.description: Drafts a policy-aware reply for one authorized review without posting or changing the review.

tools.name: search-referral-campaigns
tools.description: Searches authorized referral campaigns by name, status, message channel, and bounded performance fields.

tools.name: get-referral-campaign-attribution
tools.description: Shows verified referral campaign totals and conversion activity without returning referral tokens or bearer-like links.

tools.name: preview-referral-campaign
tools.description: Previews eligible completed jobs for one authorized referral campaign without sending or changing records.

tools.name: search-reactivation-campaigns
tools.description: Searches authorized reactivation campaigns by name, status, channel, and job-type filter.

tools.name: preview-reactivation-campaign
tools.description: Previews dormant customers eligible for one authorized reactivation campaign without sending or changing records.

tools.name: search-broadcast-campaigns
tools.description: Searches authorized broadcast campaigns by name, status, message channel, and bounded delivery fields.

tools.name: preview-broadcast-campaign
tools.description: Previews one approved broadcast audience, including suppression and policy skips, without sending or changing records.

tools.name: search-social-drafts
tools.description: Searches authorized social drafts and returns bounded content, status, platform, source-review, and approval metadata.

tools.name: preview-social-draft
tools.description: Validates social post copy for an authorized source review without saving or publishing it.

tools.name: list-job-photos
tools.description: Lists authorized private photos attached to one job with protected download URLs, filenames, captions, and media types.

tools.name: search-inventory
tools.description: Searches active inventory in the authenticated workspace and can identify low-stock items without exposing internal cost or margin fields.

tools.name: search-pricebook
tools.description: Searches active customer-facing services and materials in the authenticated workspace without exposing internal cost or markup fields.

tools.name: complaint-recall-risk
tools.description: Lists complaint and recall risk records for the authenticated workspace without exposing private operational notes.

tools.name: routing-driving-risk
tools.description: Reads a local business day route and high driving-risk stops for the authenticated workspace without exposing addresses or private route notes.

tools.name: operations-parts
tools.description: Reads bounded parts stock, technician exposure, and transaction metadata for the authenticated workspace without exposing amounts, item pricing, or private notes.

tools.name: operations-scorecards
tools.description: Reads bounded technician performance and coaching signals for the authenticated workspace without exposing coaching notes or private contact fields.

tools.name: reports-overview
tools.description: Reads aggregate revenue, receivables, job, lead, and estimate performance for the authenticated workspace without exposing customer names, addresses, invoice rows, or mutation access.

tools.name: reports-customer-revenue-rank
tools.description: Ranks named customers by paid invoice revenue for the authenticated workspace. Uses all paid, non-sample invoices and returns aggregate customer totals without invoice rows.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get-referral-campaign-attribution" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Shows verified referral campaign totals and conversion activity without returning referral tokens or bearer-like links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-service-requests, get-service-request, search-reviews, search-referral-campaigns, search-broadcast-campaigns, search-social-drafts, list-job-photos · Private data: search-customers, get-customer, search-leads, get-lead, search-service-requests, get-service-request, get-referral-campaign-attribution, preview-referral-campaign, preview-reactivation-campaign, preview-broadcast-campaign, list-job-photos, complaint-recall-risk, routing-driving-risk, operations-parts, operations-scorecards · Public sink: search-broadcast-campaigns, preview-broadcast-campaign, preview-social-draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-service-requests, get-service-request, search-reviews, search-referral-campaigns, search-broadcast-campaigns, search-social-drafts, list-job-photos · Private data: search-customers, get-customer, search-leads, get-lead, search-service-requests, get-service-request, get-referral-campaign-attribution, preview-referral-campaign, preview-reactivation-campaign, preview-broadcast-campaign, list-job-photos, complaint-recall-risk, routing-driving-risk, operations-parts, operations-scorecards · Public sink: search-broadcast-campaigns, preview-broadcast-campaign, preview-social-draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
